record: The frozen staging/QA schema the forward-migration checks are run against. Captured read-only on 2026-09-30 by scripts/backup-database.mjs. It is a logical dump and DOES contain real rows, so it lives only in gitignored backups/; the verification tool loads its schema and skips every data statement. Staging IS the ledgered migrate target for forward files; this baseline lets a change be checked before the ledger apply.
dataNote: Measured with the project splitter: 2807 statements total, 1769 of them data (1696 public rows plus 35 auth.users and 38 auth.identities). Contains personal data and password hashes — never commit, never publish. The tool re-measures this count and refuses the record if it does not match.

ledgerOnServer.note: At capture time. On 2026-10-01 the staging ledger was adopted to 169 files (see PHASE_2_MIGRATION_LEDGER.md); the capture predates that bookkeeping, not the schema.

policy.note: New files are verified here first, then applied forward through scripts/migrate.mjs so the ledger records what actually ran.
